title: PGC Canonical Transport Request V0
description: Protocol-neutral canonical transport request contract (Transport Standard V0 §5.1). Representation-independent; JSON is one serialization and is not itself normative.

operation.description: Operation Identity — the stable, protocol-neutral public name of a governed interaction. Never a Workflow Identity.

actor.description: Transport-carried governance input; delegated to the authority/context subsystem, not evaluated in V0.

context.description: Transport-carried governance input; delegated to the authority/context subsystem, not evaluated in V0.

input.description: Operation input, conforming to the TI's declared input contract.

idempotency_key.description: Reserved and declared, not enforced in V0 (carrying the key does not imply idempotent behavior).

authority.description: The authority from which this artifact's jurisdiction derives (CA-1, CA-2). Declared, never inferred from namespace, path or kind.

concern.description: The semantic subject this artifact is about (GO-11, ID-12). A concern classification confers no authority and constitutes no boundary.
